question: Does the per-epoch survivor count |C_t|(t) carry an independent omega-direction signal beyond the LC magnitude itself?
hypothesis: The |C_t|(t) breathing spectrum is a new signal channel (e.g. tracks |omega|(t) or the polhode period) not already captured by mag_hifi.
narrative_md: Decisive negative on direction (2): |C_t|(t) varies 300x with a sharp Lomb-Scargle peak at 20.5 min, but it is strongly correlated with the LC magnitude (Pearson 0.78 on log) and decoupled from |omega|(t) (0.06). Counterintuitively |C_t| is LARGER at LC peaks (1.81x). The breathing spectrum is mostly a geometric reflection of the LC magnitude, not an independent channel. Uses cached truth |omega|(t) and rotation period for the correlation -- oracle-leak, N=1.
